paras: The Rotuman forest gecko (Lepidodactylus gardineri), also known commonly as the Rotuma forest gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Rotuma Island, Fiji.
The specific name, gardineri, is in honor of British zoologist John Stanley Gardiner.
The preferred natural habitat of L. gardineri is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 256 m (840 ft).
L. gardineri is arboreal. It is found in dead tree branches, both beneath the bark and in termite galleries.
